greeting: Elder Bogwhisper on comms. Stage 2: Council of Despair. Keep formation tight and decisions tighter.
We are running The Sinking Truth. Objective drift gets teams buried.
Yesterday a corridor tried to charge me toll in riddles. I paid in sarcasm.
Action first, panic never. Start with: Defend against hostile guards.
dialog.quest_hook: Objective stack: Defend against hostile guards; Use the True Lens to reveal Void tendrils; Convince the Council with evidence. Keep route integrity while pressure escalates.
dialog.quest_active: Active pressure: Convince the Marshfolk Council that the Void is the true threat. Immediate move: Defend against hostile guards.
dialog.quest_complete: Stage 2 resolved: Council of Despair. Primary objective secured and route stabilized. Prepare for Heart of the Blight.
rumor: Boardwalk crews say the swamp now mirrors stars from the wrong season.
People keep repeating one clue from Council of Despair: 'Convince the Council with evidence'.
I saw gravity file for overtime in this sector. Management approved.
dialog.time_dawn: Dawn mist sits low in the Mire; good for stealth, bad for footing.
dialog.time_noon: Noon stirs the boardwalk gases. Keep sparks and spells controlled.
dialog.time_dusk: Dusk wakes the sink patches. Test every plank before weight transfer.
dialog.time_night: Night in swamp country means sound carries wrong. Use lantern codes.

party_reactions.kade: Elder Bogwhisper sounds intense, but the plan is solid. We keep moving.
party_reactions.nix7: Tactical profile for Elder Bogwhisper accepted. Probability of success improves with compliance.
party_reactions.twist: Elder Bogwhisper talks scary, but I like it. We punch the problem and then celebrate.

relationship_dialog.stranger: Identify your lane and your fallback.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Good timing. We can still salvage this window.
relationship_dialog.friend: You know the drill. I trust your judgment.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: If the world bends, we bend it back together.
